Dhanbad: jile ke katras men svastik sinema rod sthit ek hardaveyar dukan men achanak aag lag gaee. dekhte hi dekhte aag ne vikral rup dharan kar liya aur dukan men rakhe hardaveyar va tails samet tamam saman dhu-dhu kar jalne lage. aag itni bhayavah thi ki aaspas ke logon men aphra-taphri mach gaee.
